en.html:
I ignored Muramasa's hesitation and started running. Legs like rods, hardly any speed in them. Still, one step, then another. Jaldi. Whatever they would give me.

Soldiers' corpses lay here and there, showing the way. Breadcrumbs, and this could have been a fairy tale. But these were bodies, heavy with the smell of death. A picture of hell. Nothing else.

I ran with the dread gnawing at me.

I ignored Muramasa's hesitation and started running. Legs like rods, hardly any speed in them. Still, one step, then another. Jaldi. Whatever they would give me.

I ran with the dread gnawing at me.

ja.html:
村正の逡巡を無視して走り出す。
　棒のようになった足ではろくに速度が出なかったが、
それでも一歩に次ぐ一歩を急ぐ。

　道を示すように、兵士の骸が点々と在る。
　パン屑なら童話の一景色であろうが、屍臭濃い肉だ。
典型的な地獄絵図でしかない。

　悪しき予感に苛まれつつ、駆ける。

en.html:
Following the dead flesh, I came upon dead steel.
Four regular Rokuhara dragoons. Every one... killed with a single blow.
A skilled warrior had done this. No doubt at all.

Which meant a warrior—the strongest military force on earth—had attacked this temple. The greatest danger possible.
And already, every defence—
Every defence had been broken through————

Shit.
Move, you useless bastard. Of what use were you otherwise?
Catch that enemy, drag them down, straddle them and smash their face with my fists. Why could this body not do even that much!?

DO IT!
KAR! DO IT!!

en.html:
—The bow knight, Sagittarius, in Orichalcum armour.

I swore it. With feeling as true as love, I carved it into my heart.
Revenge.
This knight's heart I would tear out. That would be the payment for killing my adoptive father.
